description: Shared catalog of Samsung Tizen bloat groups. Every entry is evidence-based: app IDs were read from a read-only registry inventory of a real TV (docs/01-inventory.md), never guessed.
matching: Each group resolves against the device snapshot with fnmatch globs over package_app_info.app_id. A group never names a TV; profiles/<model>-<firmware>.json selects the groups that apply and adds or drops single IDs.

keep_active.reason: Widevine, PlayReady, HDCP and keystore DRM stack. Netflix, Disney+ and other streaming apps fail playback without it.
Cobalt engine hosting YouTube and other preinstalled streaming apps.
Stock settings UI on 2022+ home shells. Disabling it removes the picture, sound and network menus.
Stock home shell. UnTizen replaces the launcher container instead of disabling the shell underneath it.
Alternative stock home shell used by some firmware revisions.
Home version resolver; the shell fails to start without it.
Container UnTizen installs its launcher into. Disabling it removes the custom home.
Broadcast and system manager; live TV, source switching and power handling depend on it.
Native advanced, network and Bluetooth settings. Quiet Home does not replace these screens.

advertising.description: ACR, viewing analysis, ad serving and promotion components. Package names identify purpose; this is not a traffic audit.

tv-plus.description: Samsung TV Plus free-streaming service and its startup hooks. Removes access to that app until restored.

voice.description: Bixby, Alexa, wake-word engines and voice UI. Opt in only if voice functions are unwanted; the remote's mic button stops working.

context.description: AI companions, context-aware suggestions and content-grab features. May remove useful smart functions such as 'what is this actor'.

smart-extras.description: SmartThings, ambient sound, always-on-vision dashboard, gaming background helpers and Samsung Health. Optional for an HDMI-focused setup.

gaming-hub.description: Cloud gaming hub and its overlays. Safe to disable when consoles are connected over HDMI; input handling is independent of these packages.

hotel-b2b.description: Hospitality and B2B signage stacks shipped on retail units: hotel menus, cloning, remote device management, hit-comp and banner services.

light-shell.description: Stock sidebar and web browser. Apply only after the launcher, the QuickLaunch bridge and settings routing are validated.
